text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —An open training session?
choice_data_list: We've had a lot of requests from Ace's fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I suggested fulfilling the request to Katsuragi Ace to build up anticipation for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. Well, they did go out of their way
to come watch my training just because
they wanted to see me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Got it!
Since we're here, let's do a public training session.
It'll help me get my head in the game, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so arrived the day of the public training session.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's here...! Katsuragi Ace!!
Thanks for everything today--!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Great work out thereee!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, huh—aren't there a ton of them!?
Trainer! I thought you said only fans
near the training camp would be gathered—
choice_data_list: Sorry. The truth is, people gather here from all over the country.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Nationwide, you mean—
choice_data_list: Even this is only a fraction of it, though.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? I mean, I appreciate it, but...
Wait, why are you going this far—

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace-san. Before your training begins,
could you please listen to us for a moment
on behalf of everyone gathered here?

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who gathered here today...
they all came to show you their support and gratitude...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Gratitude...?
choice_data_list: Let's hear them out for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Please tell me.
Tell me everyone's stories—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few people stepped forward from the crowd of fans.
After bowing to Katsuragi Ace and the other fans,
they began to speak...

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text: —A few years ago, I moved to Tokyo from the countryside and landed my dream job, but it turned out to be an intensely competitive place.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text: I was a country bumpkin, naive to the ways of the world, from a poor family, and constantly felt out of place every day... but because I had a dream I wanted to fulfill, I was able to keep trying my best.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text:
Still, as things gradually failed to go my way and piled up...
before I knew it, my desire to give it my all started to fade...—

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text: "—It was right around then that I happened to watch your race."

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text: Watching you shout at the top of your lungs and race forward with everything you had left a truly powerful impact on me.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text:
So I got curious and looked into your past, and...
I just felt this overwhelming...
well, uninvited sense of sympathy toward your career.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text: As I followed your races, your running—your battles—began to give me courage too...

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I started feeling like...
I had to "fight," just like you...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...With my running—

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text:
"I was the same way. I had no pride in where I came from
or how I was raised, it was a huge complex of mine,
and I spent all my time living with a defeatist mindset—"

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text: Back when I had nothing better to do and was just casually wandering around the racetrack, I happened to watch your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text: Compared to the other girls in your class, your track record honestly wasn't that notable, but seeing you run with all your might and work toward the future—

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text:
"I started following you out of a dark curiosity,
wondering ‘just how long can she keep trying like that?’
Yet from there, you rose all the way to the top—"

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, she came to fight at the center of the era!
That was so incredibly cool... and so moving...—

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text:
And at the same time—
I realized just how uncool I looked...!
Chasing after you with such a negative attitude—

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna change...! I wanna fight...!!
Just like Katsuragi Ace... I felt like
I could move forward into the future too...!"

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text: You're the one who gave me... the will to fight!!

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text: Everyone here isn't just cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them resonated with
the journey you've walked up to this day...
and drew courage from it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: ...There's something we all want to show you.
...There's something we all want to show you.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fans
text_block_list.text: Ooooone, two, ready, GO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace's fans erected a single long iron pole,
as if piercing straight into the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And catching the wind—
the giant flag fluttered grandly against the evening sky."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: “Katsuragi”... “Ace”...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a flag emblazoned with a valiant dragon and boldly embroidered with the name "Katsuragi Ace."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's a banner crafted by the fans in the design of Katsuragi Ace's racing silks, filled with their encouragement and gratitude for her.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text: "We will follow your lead! We will fight just like you!! That's why...!"

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hooooray! Hooooray!
Katsuragi Ace!!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Do your best!! Don't lose!!
Our "Ace"!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text: ...The current Twinkle Series isn't just about Mr. C.B. and Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative B
text_block_list.text:
We believe that if it's Katsuragi Ace,
she can definitely shatter this era
where everyone only expects things from CB and the others.

text_block_list.name: Ace Fan Representative A
text_block_list.text:
Please remember this.
Every single one of us loves your running, your way of life,
more than anything else...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Everyone.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much—
for everything!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I have received them.
Everyone's feelings... right here... all of them!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Please watch me. I swear I'll show you...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Who is at the very top...!
Who is the true "Ace" of the Umamusume world...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Impossibility, 'different worlds'—
I'll smash them all to pieces!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace is here!!!
With everyone's feelings as my banner!!!!
I'm gonna shout it for all to hear!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that instant, a flame ignited in Katsuragi Ace's eyes... A colossal blaze that felt like it would scorch heaven and earth alike...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... haah...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hah... phew...—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
So give it your all, Ace-chan...!
As our—"Ace"!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you looking so cool out there, Es-cchi,
gives us the strength to keep our chins up...!
Thank you! You're our true "Ace"!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Do your best!! Don't lose!!
Our "Ace"!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (...How strange.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(All I did was run looking straight ahead.
Yet before I knew it, everyone started calling me their "ace.")

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (I don't feel burdened by it at all—if anything, power is surging through me... It's heating me up...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I want to answer their calls.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "No, I have to deliver...! Without fail...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —You've got a great look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
How about it? Up for a quick run?
Just over that way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Sure, why not.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ――After you, sucker!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, nice!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah, haah—! 
C... C.B.------!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!
I'm definitelyyyyy gonna wiiiiiiin!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!!
I'm not gonna lose!! Neither am I!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this, Ace!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Aaargh!! Let's do thissss!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —I just can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I saw Ace run
in the Osaka Hai and Takarazuka Kinen...
racing has been...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I thought maybe I didn't need to put it into words every single time.
Still, I don't want any misunderstandings, so I'll say it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "Ever since our three-match showdown in our Classic Year, Ace has been my rival. No matter what anyone says."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It can't just be anyone.
Right now, I want it to be with you—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I want to race against Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Don't you forget that, okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Like hell I'll ever forget...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Thank you. Everyone cheering for me... C.B.... Trainer—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace thrusts her fist toward the sky.
The sun was about to illuminate the world once again today—
